pairs.evidence: clients/python/lighttrack/instrument.py:3 The SDK is a telemetry wrapper. It intercepts the host application's already-built provider calls and records model, token counts and latency (instrument.py:183); it owns no assembler, template or transcript. A case-insensitive search of clients/python for system_prompt, template, compact, fingerprint and assemble found no hits, so the subject's precondition (a system that owns its assembler) does not hold here.
